description: This file defines an abstract Java class `MidiPortSelector` which functions as a UI component for selecting MIDI ports using an Android Spinner widget. It manages MIDI device connections, updates the UI based on device status changes, and provides an interface for handling port selection and cleanup.

classes.name: MidiPortSelector
classes.description: An abstract class that uses an Android Spinner to facilitate selection among available MIDI ports. It manages device callback registration, UI updates, and port activity monitoring, requiring subclasses to implement port selection handling and resource cleanup.

methods.name: MidiPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MIDI port selector, registers device callbacks, populates initial device info, and sets up UI interactions.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Resets the spinner selection to no port.

methods.name: onDeviceAdded
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new MIDI device is added; adds corresponding port representations to the UI.

methods.name: onDeviceRemoved
methods.description: Callback invoked when a MIDI device is removed; removes related port entries from the UI.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in device port status, updating UI elements to reflect busy or free ports.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented to handle user selection of a MIDI port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for cleanup tasks.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Calls the cleanup method `onClose()` to release resources.
